gloss: right of residence; right to live somewhere

definitions.gloss: right of residence; right to live somewhere
definitions.explanation: The legal right to reside in a particular place, whether in a specific property or in a country.

examples.japanese: {居住権|きょじゅうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{守|まも}られている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: The right of residence is protected by law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配偶者|はいぐうしゃ}→配偶者：07430_haiguusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{居住権|きょじゅうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: The spouse is granted the right of residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{居住権|きょじゅうけん}をめぐって⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Disputes can arise among family members over the right of residence during inheritance proceedings.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{居住|きょじゅう}→居住：06812_kyojuu⟧ (residence/dwelling) and {権|けん} (right). In Japanese law, the ⟦{配偶者|はいぐうしゃ}→配偶者：07430_haiguusha⟧{居住権|きょじゅうけん} (spouse's right of residence) was formally established in 2020 as part of civil code reforms, allowing a surviving spouse to continue living in their home even after inheritance.
